from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,warnings
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('paper_output/code/review_delivery').resolve()))
import dryingCore as dc
import analyticJacobian as aj
out=Path('notes/A-modeling/2026-09-11/effects-rounding/截图易错点_物理与数值复核.json')
result={'status':'LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKS','created_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'new_PDE_solves':0,'process_exit_code':None,'checks':[]}
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    m=dc.RadialModel(dc.Settings(question='Q1',intervals=16,faceScheme='kirchhoff',constantD=5e-9))
    y=m.initial();y[:-1:2]=301.15+8*m.x**2;y[1:-1:2]=2.55-.5*m.x**2
    f=m.rhs(1000.,y)
    expectedT=4*(.36/(820*2600))*8/.02**2
    expectedC=4*5e-9*(-.5)/.02**2
    result['checks'].append({'id':'CENTER_POLYNOMIAL','N':16,'T_center_rhs_K_s':float(f[0]),'expected_T':expectedT,'C_center_rhs_per_s':float(f[1]),'expected_C':expectedC,'center_weight':float(m.w[0]),'all_finite':bool(np.isfinite(f).all()),'pass':bool(abs(f[0]-expectedT)<1e-12 and abs(f[1]-expectedC)<1e-15)})
    for q in ['Q1','Q23','Q4']:
        m=dc.RadialModel(dc.Settings(question=q,intervals=12,faceScheme='kirchhoff',shrink=(q=='Q4')))
        y=m.initial();y[:-1:2]=309+6*m.x**2;y[1:-1:2]=2.4-1.9*m.x**2
        J=aj.jacobian(m,18000.,y).toarray()
        iT=np.arange(0,2*m.n,2);iC=iT+1
        tc=float(np.max(abs(J[np.ix_(iT,iC)])));ct=float(np.max(abs(J[np.ix_(iC,iT)])))
        T=y[:-1:2];C=y[1:-1:2]
        f=m.rhs(18000.,y)
        yC=y.copy();yC[1:-1:2]*=.9;fC=m.rhs(18000.,yC)
        yT=y.copy();yT[:-1:2]+=3;fT=m.rhs(18000.,yT)
        changedTC=float(np.max(abs(fC[:-1:2]-f[:-1:2])))
        changedCT=float(np.max(abs(fT[1:-1:2]-f[1:-1:2])))
        d=m.properties(T,C)[3];dT=m.properties(T+3,C)[3];dC=m.properties(T,.9*C)[3]
        result['checks'].append({'id':'CROSS_COUPLING_'+q,'max_abs_dTdot_dC':tc,'max_abs_dCdot_dT':ct,'direct_C_perturb_heat_change':changedTC,'direct_T_perturb_water_change':changedCT,'D_changes_with_C':bool(np.any(dC!=d)),'D_changes_with_T':bool(np.any(dT!=d)),'pass':bool((tc==ct==changedTC==changedCT==0) if q=='Q1' else (tc>0 and ct>0 and changedTC>0 and changedCT>0))})
    for T,C,label in [(300.,.2,'DRYING_HEATING'),(340.,.02,'WETTING_COOLING')]:
        m=dc.RadialModel(dc.Settings(question='Q1',intervals=12,faceScheme='kirchhoff'))
        y=m.initial();y[:-1:2]=T;y[1:-1:2]=C
        f=m.rhs(18000.,y);R=float(m.radius(18000.));Ta,Ce=m.environment(18000.)
        meanT=float(np.dot(2*m.w,f[:-1:2]));meanC=float(np.dot(2*m.w,f[1:-1:2]))
        expectedT=2*25*(float(Ta)-T)/(R*820*2600);expectedC=-2*8e-7*(C-float(Ce))/R
        result['checks'].append({'id':'BOUNDARY_'+label,'T_uniform_K':T,'C_uniform':C,'air_T_K':float(Ta),'effective_Ceq':float(Ce),'surface_Tdot':float(f[-3]),'surface_Cdot':float(f[-2]),'mean_Tdot':meanT,'expected_mean_Tdot':expectedT,'mean_Cdot':meanC,'expected_mean_Cdot':expectedC,'mass_residual':meanC+float(f[-1]),'pass':bool(abs(meanT-expectedT)<1e-15 and abs(meanC-expectedC)<1e-18)})
    m=dc.RadialModel(dc.Settings(question='Q4',intervals=12,faceScheme='kirchhoff',shrink=True,constantD=5e-9,constantThermal=True))
    y=m.initial();y[:-1:2]=301.15+8*m.x**2;y[1:-1:2]=2.55-.5*m.x**2
    t=36000.;R=float(m.radius(t));f=m.rhs(t,y)
    expectedT=4*(.36/(820*2600))*8/R**2;expectedC=4*5e-9*(-.5)/R**2
    result['checks'].append({'id':'SHRINK_R_MINUS_2_CENTER','time_s':t,'radius_m':R,'Tdot_center':float(f[0]),'expected_Tdot_center':expectedT,'Cdot_center':float(f[1]),'expected_Cdot_center':expectedC,'mass_residual':float(np.dot(2*m.w,f[1:-1:2])+f[-1]),'pass':bool(abs(f[0]-expectedT)<1e-12 and abs(f[1]-expectedC)<1e-15)})
result['warnings']=[str(w.message) for w in caught]
paths=['paper_output/code/review_delivery/dryingCore.py','paper_output/code/review_delivery/analyticJacobian.py','paper_output/code/modeling/drying_core.py','problem_files/CUMCM2026Problems/A题/A题.pdf','paper_output/code/review_delivery/q1Model.py','paper_output/code/review_delivery/q2Model.py','paper_output/code/review_delivery/q4Model.py']
result['sources']=[{'path':p,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':Path(p).stat().st_size} for p in paths]
result['all_local_checks_pass']=all(c['pass'] for c in result['checks'])
result['limitations']=['No new PDE integration','Manufactured/local states do not prove global convergence or positivity','Q1 decoupling refers to supplied Q1 properties and no latent/temperature-dependent moisture boundary','Source comment on original air concentration basis is misleading, numerical effective boundary unchanged']
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
assert result['all_local_checks_pass']
